data.name: Shera
data.long_meaning: Shera is a Sanskrit and Hindi name which means 'lioness'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shri', meaning 'goddess of wealth and prosperity', and the Sanskrit word 'ra', meaning 'king'. This name embodies the strength and courage of a lioness, as well as the feminine energy of a goddess.
